title: When All Thy Mercies, O My God
description: When All Thy Mercies, O My God in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: Joseph Addison wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 72.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: When all Thy mer-cies, O my God, My ris-ing soul sur-veys, Trans-port-ed with the view, I’m lost In won-der, love, and praise.

lines: When all Thy mercies, O my God,
Transported with the view, I’m lost
Nor is the least a cheerful heart,
That tastes those gifts with joy.
Through every period of my life
And after death, in distant worlds,
When nature fails, and day and night
My ever grateful heart, O Lord,

licence: Public domain: Joseph Addison died in 1719.
credits: Words by Joseph Addison (1672–1719), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
